title: Service maintenance and support for GE MUSE NX
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > 262-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 22 (36C262)
description:
This is a Sources Sought Notice only. This Sources Sought Notice is not a request for competitive quotes and no solicitation is available. All interested parties must respond to the Sources Sought Notice in writing. The Government is requesting an informal quote for these services in addition to a capability statement using the included price schedule found on the last page of this Sources Sought Notice. The informal quote is for market research purposes only and will not form a binding agreement. 

  SEE ATTACHED SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE DOCUMENT FOR DRAFT SOW AND PRICE SCHEDULE.  

  Background:  The GE MUSE NX System is an enterprise cardiac information management system (CIMS) developed by GE HealthCare. It centralizes, analyzes, and stores diagnostic electrocardiogram (ECG/EKG) data from resting, stress, and ambulatory systems. A service contract protects patients by preventing diagnostic delays, preserving historical heart data integrity, and securing sensitive medical records against cyber threats. 

  Required Services:  The services to be provided by the contractor under this agreement shall consist of furnishing all necessary parts, labor, transportation, and access required to provide required support and maintenance for VA Long Beach’s GE MUSE NX system 

  Intent to sole source:  if no responses are received that indicate interested and capable vendors, the Government intends to issue a sole source award to the OEM, GE Healthcare, who has previously provided these services to VA Long Beach Healthcare System.
